description: An oil-painted scene of a bearded man in a dark coat and white collar, seen from the side, looking through a brass telescope held up at an open window. The telescope's lens shows a Gothic church with two tall spires. Through the window are a canal with a boat, brick houses with stepped gables and a distant spire. On the sill at lower left sit a brass telescope on a stand and a second brass telescope lying flat. The only mark is a small sparkle logo in the bottom-right corner, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame. Nothing violent or graphic is shown.
